## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you would like.

## Problem / Use Case
What problem does this solve? Which OS or provider workflow benefits?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision it working (tray/menu bar behavior, CLI `--status-json`, Settings, notifications, etc.).

## Alternatives Considered
Any workarounds or alternative approaches you've tried or considered.
